title: neurofeedback app I am building
author: FireDragon21976
selftext:
I built this neurofeedback app using Fable for the code, and Astra for some of the artwork.   It can use any Muse headband or Bluetooth heart rate sensor (with or without explicit HRV support)   It has about three basic scenes- character meditating in forest and levitating in response to target brainwaves, a vista over a lake, and an HRV trainer inspired by the Wii game Leela.   The basic code and features are done but I think it could use a bit more polish.

Fable chose the name Zanshin: the Abiding Mind.
